name: D'lite granola almond and pumpkin seeds
ingredients_raw: Oats (58.4%), Sweeteners (Maltitol, 5850 mg/portion*, Steviol Glycosides, 3 mg/portion*), Vegetable Oil (Palm), Soy Protein Isolate, Almond (3.5%), Pumpkin Seeds (3.5%), Millet, Rice Crisps, Fructo Oligosaccharides, Coconut Powder, Calcium, Iron, Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin), Leavening Agent (E500), Salt, Natural Vanilla Flavour. Allergen: Contains Gluten, Nuts and Soy. Excessive Consumption Could Have Laxative Effects
